text:
alex: Heads-up — ACME private deploy kickoff today. Need final network checklist and air-gap blockers list. Who's owning peering + firewall rule approval?

maria: @alex I can take peering and topology sign-off. I need the CIDR mapping from customer and the list of allowed management IPs.

chen: @maria I already have ACME's CIDRs in the ticket (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-842). Will paste here: 10.10.0.0/16, 192.168.50.0/24.

jordan: Quick note — for private we need HSM on the HSM-enabled hosts; security needs final approval before GA. @sarah any blockers on HSM certs?

sarah: HSM certs waiting on legal for the DPA addendum, still in review. ETA EOD tomorrow. Main air-gap blocker: firmware signing key exchange hasn't been completed.

ravi: For the air-gapped package sync, ops needs a signed tarball and the metadata manifest. We saw failures on last test where the manifest signature was invalid.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: network acl ✅, vpc peers pending, certs pending, package-manifest validation failed on mirror-2.

alex: Action items: (1) @maria own peering + firewall PR; (2) @sarah chase legal for DPA/HSM signoff; (3) @ravi reproduce manifest signature error and create minimal repro; (4) @chen confirm CIDRs and add to infra repo. Target milestone: customer-ready smoke test by Fri 09:00 PT.

maria: Starting firewall PR now. Draft rules (we'll lock down later):
```
- allow tcp 22 from ACME_mgmt_ips
- allow tcp 443 from ALB
- allow inter-node 6000-6100 from internal CIDR
```
I'll request review from @chen and @ravi.

ravi: Repro steps for manifest signature: I ran the local mirror sync with the offline key and saw SHA mismatch. Suspect timestamp vs canonicalization issue. I'll attach logs to the ticket.

chen: Added CIDRs to infra repo in branch feature/acme-cidrs. Also added a quick validation script: `scripts/validate-cidrs.sh`. PTAL.

alex: Thanks — can each owner drop a one-liner status update here when done? I'll keep a running checklist in the ticket. If any blocker looks like a >4h hit for the Fri smoke test, flag it ASAP. :thumbsup:

maria: PR up at https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1187 — needs 1 reviewer.

sarah: Legal said DPA review meeting scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Pushing for HSM cert exception if needed.

ravi: Log dump uploaded to the ticket. Repro attached. If it's timestamp canonicalization, fix should be small.

alex: Great. Next sync is async here; we'll only do a short call if anything slips. Thanks all.
